Accordingly, the interest rates for the Credit Facility will </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:573pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">vary during the term of the credit agreement based on changes in the applicable base rates, applicable term rates or future </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:585pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">changes to our credit rating.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:609pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The credit agreement also requires that the Company pay certain facility fees on the aggregate unused commitments </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:621pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">under the Credit Facility and certain letter of credit issuance and fronting fees. Letters of credit will be available for </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:633pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">issuance under the Credit Facilit</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:187.76pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">y</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:192.76pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> and will reduce availability under the Credit Facility.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:657pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">We are permitted to voluntarily reduce the unutilized portion of the revolving commitments and repay outstanding </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:669pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">loans under the Credit Facility at any time without premium or penalty, subject to customary breakage costs. We may </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:681pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">request a one-year extension of the maturity date of the Credit Facility (not more than two times during the life of the </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:693pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Credit Facility) under certain conditions customary for financings of this type.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:717pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The credit agreement contains certain affirmative and negative covenants</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:375.31pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:377.81pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">that, among other things, limit our and our </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:729pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">subsidiaries&#8217; ability to merge and/or dispose of all, substantially all or a substantial portion of our assets, incur additional </span></div></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:45pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">subsidiary indebtednes</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:149.8pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">s, and i</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:178.39pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">ncur certain lien</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:243.28pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">s</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:247.17pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:252.17pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">In addition, the credit agreement requires that we maintain a total net </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:57pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">leverage ratio of not greater than </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:191.64pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">3.50</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:209.14pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> to 1.00 with, at our election and subject to certain customary conditions, a step-up to </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:69pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">4.00</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:76pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> to 1.00 for the four fiscal quarters ending immediately following a qualifying material acquisition (including the fiscal </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:81pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">quarter that such qualifying material acquisition was consummated). The credit agreement also contains certain customary </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:93pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">events of default, subject to certain thresholds and grace periods, including but not limited to payment default, material </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:105pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">inaccuracy of a material representation, breach of covenants, cross-acceleration to material debt and change of control. If </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:117pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">an event of default, as specified in the credit agreement, shall occur and be continuing, we may be required to repay all </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:129pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">amounts outstanding under the Credit Facility.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:153pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The Company incurred financing costs in connection with the Credit Facility, which are recorded as deferred </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:165pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">financing costs within other assets and are amortized over the term of the facility. Commitment fees are recognized as </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:177pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">interest expense as incurred. As of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:198.62pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">June&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:254.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">, there were </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:303.81pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">no</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:313.81pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> outstanding borrowings under the Credit Facility.</span></div><span></span>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for information about short-term and long-term debt arrangements, which includes amounts of borrowings under each line of credit, note payable, commercial paper issue, bonds indenture, debenture issue, own-share lending arrangements and any other contractual agreement to repay funds, and about the underlying arrangements, rationale for a classification as long-term, including repayment terms, interest rates, collateral provided, restrictions on use of assets and activities, whether or not in compliance with debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements, such as the effects of refinancing and noncompliance with debt covenants.</p></div>
